title: LG-CHECKPOINT178: coherent Boolean-oracle checkpointing reduces full endpoint quantum exponent

claims.statement: For the single fixed uniform LG-CHECKPOINT178 physical algorithm supplied completely in proof.md and virtual.md (finite tester for ell=ceil(log2 n)<2^20; otherwise u2=ceil(sqrt(n)),V=u2,h=floor(ell/2)-5,f=2^h,bQ=256+16ell,budgetQ=floor(51*u2/500)-bQ,cbar=floor(ell/2)+6,denQ=n*h+f²*cbar,y=floor(n*(budgetQ-f-1)/denQ),w=ceil(n/((f-h)y)),q=f+ceil((f-1)*cbar/(w+1)), enlarged uniform-height MERGEG capacities, full-b-bit root flag/filter, exact source/cap guards, both full-modulus decoders and counted physical compiler), for every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), unconditional ENTIRE-secret success is at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. Jointly on EVERY branch T=O(2^((869/200)*sqrt(n)*log2 n)), ordinary classical workspace O(n), full allocated quantum workspace O(n^291), and total source acquisitions O(2^((51/500)*sqrt(n))). Every failure, discard, partial attempt, source guard, retry, abort, initialization, finite exact epoch repair, full address debit, source move and cleanup is included with absolute outside constants and the exact displayed exponent coefficients. The corresponding upper envelope has exact index1/2. The ACTUALphysical layout selectsA=2^16n,R=2^160n5Uell,Wrow=2^16n,H=2^96n5Uell,512-position scalar components with full original labels/domains,additionalrawtype descriptors,and e=16ceil(sqrt n)*ceilLogn per-bit epoch bits with exact finite repair. OriginalrootK/local/conservativeLEguards remain; no cumulativeguard is selected. The TREE/MARK phaseoracle block ofvirtual6.3 step2(b) uses the supplied exact coherent checkpoint compiler,S=2^55n5U,T0=2^256n32U4,k=ceilLogT0,with no historical gate cache; its complete unknown scratch,prefix and polynomial time overhead are counted. Original source/guards/rotations and macro instruments are preserved.
